\section[(dialogue)]{Nature — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R139-first-pass-nature}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a waist and an elbow.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item figs, a watermelon, apricots, soup, a cake
  \item grass, a seed, a root, a branch, an island
  \item a coast, a waterfall, a cave, a valley, a hill
  \item a desert, a lake, lightning, thunder, a storm
  \item light, shade, darkness, a cloud, a rabbit
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Figs? (\textbf{\ar{تين}}, \emph{tīn}.) A watermelon? (\textbf{\ar{بطيخ}}, \emph{biṭṭīkh}.) Apricots? (\textbf{\ar{مشمش}}, \emph{mishmish}.) Soup? (\textbf{\ar{حساء}}, \emph{ḥasāʾ}.) A cake? (\textbf{\ar{كعكة}}, \emph{kaʿka}.) Grass? (\textbf{\ar{عشب}}, \emph{ʿushb}.) A seed? (\textbf{\ar{بذرة}}, \emph{bidhra}.) A root? (\textbf{\ar{جذر}}, \emph{jidhr}.) A branch? (\textbf{\ar{غصن}}, \emph{ghuṣn}.) An island? (\textbf{\ar{جزيرة}}, \emph{jazīra}.) A coast? (\textbf{\ar{ساحل}}, \emph{sāḥil}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\ar{شلال}}, \emph{shallāl}.) A cave? (\textbf{\ar{كهف}}, \emph{kahf}.) A valley? (\textbf{\ar{وادي}}, \emph{wādī}.) A hill? (\textbf{\ar{تل}}, \emph{tall}.) A desert? (\textbf{\ar{صحراء}}, \emph{ṣaḥrāʾ}.) A lake? (\textbf{\ar{بحيرة}}, \emph{buḥayra}.) Lightning? (\textbf{\ar{برق}}, \emph{barq}.) Thunder? (\textbf{\ar{رعد}}, \emph{raʿd}.) A storm? (\textbf{\ar{عاصفة}}, \emph{ʿāṣifa}.) Light? (\textbf{\ar{ضوء}}, \emph{ḍawʾ}.) Shade? (\textbf{\ar{ظل}}, \emph{ẓill}.) Darkness? (\textbf{\ar{ظلام}}, \emph{ẓalām}.) A cloud? (\textbf{\ar{غيمة}}, \emph{ghayma}.) A rabbit? (\textbf{\ar{أرنب}}, \emph{arnab}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R139-second-pass-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a gazelle and a fox.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a gazelle, a fox, a pigeon, a duck, a turtle
  \item a crocodile, a mosquito, a fly, a bee, a butterfly
  \item a spider, a rooster, a cat, an owl, a crow
  \item an eagle, a frog, a cheek, a forehead, an eyebrow
  \item a beard, a moustache, a chest, a waist, an elbow
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A gazelle? (\textbf{\ar{غزال}}, \emph{ghazāl}.) A fox? (\textbf{\ar{ثعلب}}, \emph{thaʿlab}.) A pigeon? (\textbf{\ar{حمامة}}, \emph{ḥamāma}.) A duck? (\textbf{\ar{بطة}}, \emph{baṭṭa}.) A turtle? (\textbf{\ar{سلحفاة}}, \emph{sulaḥfāh}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\ar{تمساح}}, \emph{timsāḥ}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{\ar{بعوضة}}, \emph{baʿūḍa}.) A fly? (\textbf{\ar{ذبابة}}, \emph{dhubāba}.) A bee? (\textbf{\ar{نحلة}}, \emph{naḥla}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\ar{فراشة}}, \emph{farāsha}.) A spider? (\textbf{\ar{عنكبوت}}, \emph{ʿankabūt}.) A rooster? (\textbf{\ar{ديك}}, \emph{dīk}.) A cat? (\textbf{\ar{قطة}}, \emph{qiṭṭa}.) An owl? (\textbf{\ar{بومة}}, \emph{būma}.) A crow? (\textbf{\ar{غراب}}, \emph{ghurāb}.) An eagle? (\textbf{\ar{نسر}}, \emph{nasr}.) A frog? (\textbf{\ar{ضفدع}}, \emph{ḍifdaʿ}.) A cheek? (\textbf{\ar{خد}}, \emph{khadd}.) A forehead? (\textbf{\ar{جبين}}, \emph{jabīn}.) An eyebrow? (\textbf{\ar{حاجب}}, \emph{ḥājib}.) A beard? (\textbf{\ar{لحية}}, \emph{liḥya}.) A moustache? (\textbf{\ar{شارب}}, \emph{shārib}.) A chest? (\textbf{\ar{صدر}}, \emph{ṣadr}.) A waist? (\textbf{\ar{خصر}}, \emph{khaṣr}.) An elbow? (\textbf{\ar{مرفق}}, \emph{mirfaq}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
